description:
Goal
When no handler matches an event, telemetry must perform no payload construction, transformation, allocation, timing, span-stack mutation, or durable state work; a statically null sink must be optimizable away.

Contract
- Emit-site payload expressions are evaluated only after the sink proves a matching handler exists.
- Raw references are borrowed only for the synchronous handler call.
- A handler that retains data owns every copy/allocation needed for retention.
- Span names are static borrowed paths; disabled spans allocate nothing, do not call Instant::now, and do not mutate ids/stacks.
- The null/no-handler path is statically representable so compiler code can be stripped by optimization rather than hidden behind &dyn Telemetry calls.

Current violations
TelemetryExt::span eagerly accepts constructed Metadata, calls span_start, boxes the name, and starts Instant. ConfiguredTelemetry always reads/mutates RefCell span state and ids even with zero/mismatched handlers. metadata!/measurements! eagerly evaluate all expressions before dispatch. Compiler2 stores &dyn Telemetry, preventing devirtualization of a known null sink.

Strategy
Redesign the sink around handler-interest queries plus lazy event/span payload closures, or an equivalent API with the same proof. Introduce a zero-sized null implementation and thread telemetry generically/static where required for dead-code elimination; do not add emit-site if enabled boilerplate. Preserve prefix routing at the configured-handler boundary.

TDD
Use side-effecting/allocation-counting payload expressions to prove they are not evaluated for no handlers and nonmatching prefixes. Prove disabled spans allocate/timestamp/mutate nothing. Add a release-codegen or structural generic/null test sufficient to guard devirtualization.

Acceptance
- No-handler and nonmatching-prefix paths do no telemetry work beyond an erasable branch/call.
- Existing handlers still receive event-scoped borrows synchronously.
- No compatibility eager API remains.
- Docs, full tests, and clippy pass.
title: Make telemetry emission lazy and the no-handler path erasable
